subject: gk
question: In India, the responsibility of conducting the decadal census rests with which ministry?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 1**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Registrar General and Census Commissioner, India, **under the** Ministry of Home Affairs**, is responsible for conducting the decennial Census.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ministry of Finance: **This ministry is responsible for the fiscal policy of the government, including managing public finance, preparation of the annual budget, and taxation policies.

 
 
• It consists of five departments: **Department of Economic Affairs, Department of Expenditure, Department of Revenue, Department of Investment and Public Asset Management, and Department of Financial Services.**
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Corporate Affairs:** This ministry deals with the administration of laws related to corporate behavior in India, including the Companies Act, the Competition Act, and other related laws.
 
 
• It also supervises the functioning of professional bodies like** Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI), Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ICSI), and Institute of Cost Accountants of India (ICAI).**
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation:** This ministry is charged with the coverage and quality aspects of statistics released in the country.
 
 
• The two wings of this ministry are the **Central Statistics Office (CSO) and the National Sample Survey Office (NSSO)**.
 
• The ministry is also tasked with the implementation of centrally sponsored schemes.
